title.en: Providing for Special Group Term Insurance By the Government Service Insurance System or Other Insurance Firms for Members of the Armed Forces of the Philippines and Appropriating Funds for the Payment of the Government Share of the Premiums Therefor

text.en:
Subject to such terms and conditions that may be agreed upon by the Government Service
Insurance System or other insurance firms and the Chief of Staff, Armed Forces of the Philippines, including
the rates of the insurance, premiums, fifty percent (50%) of which shall be paid by each member of the Armed
Forces of the Philippines and fifty percent (50%) by the Government as its counterpart premium contribution,
and approved by the Secretary of National Defense, each member of the Armed Forces of the Philippines in
the active, including cadets of Philippine Military Academy and the Philippine Air Force Flying School,
probationary officers, trainees and draftees, shall be insured under an annual special group term coverage
program, renewable annually thereafter, in an amount not exceeding P6,000.00 per member, in addition to the
compulsory insurance for members of the Armed Forces of the Philippines by the Government Service
Insurance System as provided by existing law.

Such amounts as may be necessary for the government's counterpart as herein provided are
hereby appropriated out of funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated; thereafter, such sums as
may be required for the purpose shall be included in the annual appropriations of the Armed Forces of the
Philippines.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of December, in the year of our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
